declared whole grain: 38.3% whole wheat + 3% whole oat = 41.3% whole > 20.6% whole wheat + 8.6% whole oat + 4.9% whole wheat flour = 34.1% whole. Same product family (Fitness bars), moderate 7.2pp declared gap. Stresses tightened mixed-band sensitivity beyond the 0.5pt edge cases.
pair_results.stress_target: mixed-band sensitivity — moderate gap (7.2pp) within same product family

pair_results.pair_reason: שיבולת שועל מלאה 56% declared (first ingredient, dominant) with nuts 11%+seeds as non-grain whole > שיבולת שועל 38% with palm oil second, refined white flour, glucose syrup. Grain whole gap 18pp is unambiguous even without the nut contribution. Tests: a high-oat product with significant nuts (stresses non-grain 0.5x rule) must still outrank a lower-oat product.
pair_results.stress_target: grain-context 0.5x non-grain rule — high-oat+nuts product vs lower-oat+refined product

pair_results.pair_reason: declared whole grain: שיבולת שועל מלאה 44.5% + קמח חיטה מלא 14.7% + קמח שיבולת שועל מלא 4.2% + פתיתי חיטה מלאה 2.8% = 66.2% whole grain declared > גריסי תירס 26% (refined, first) + קמח חיטה מלא 25% (second). 66.2% vs 25% whole, 41.2pp gap.
pair_results.stress_target: large declared whole-grain gap vs refined-first product

pair_results.pair_reason: קמח שיפון מלא 70% of total flour (declared) > קמח חיטה לבן 75% of total flour (declared), whole grain only 25% of flour. 70% whole-flour vs 25% whole-flour — 45pp declared gap in flour composition.
pair_results.stress_target: high declared whole-flour% vs refined-dominant sourdough (both mixed breads with declared flour splits)

pair_results.pair_reason: כוסמין מלא 70% of total flour (declared) > קמח חיטה מלא first but NO % stated, קמח חיטה לבן third — ratio unknown (position-only). 70% declared whole-flour vs position-only unknown.
pair_results.stress_target: declared 70% whole-flour vs position-only unknown-ratio mixed bread

pair_results.pair_reason: קמח חיטה מלא 72% + קמח שיפון מלא 12% = 84% declared whole grain content (by weight of flour fractions as listed) > קמח חיטה מלא 30.5% + קמח אורז מלא 6.8% = 37.3% declared whole. 84% vs 37.3% — 46.7pp declared gap.
pair_results.stress_target: very high declared whole% (both fractions stated) vs moderate mixed cracker

pair_results.pair_reason: grain whole: חיטה מלאה 29.6% + קמח חיטה מלא 7.9% + שיבולת שועל מלאה 1.9% = 39.4% grain whole, plus שקדים 7% non-grain whole > grain whole: חיטה מלאה 20.6% + שיבולת שועל מלאה 8.6% + קמח חיטה מלא 4.9% = 34.1% grain whole, no nuts. Gap: 5.3pp grain whole. STRESS: higher product has nuts (penalized 0.5x in grain context) — even with penalty, 39.4% grain whole must rank above 34.1% grain whole with no nuts. Tests proportionality of the 0.5x rule: penalty must not invert a clear grain-based ranking.
pair_results.stress_target: 0.5x non-grain rule stress — nuts alongside grain must not invert a clear grain-based ranking gap

pair_results.pair_reason: שיבולת שועל 39% direct stated (higher) > granola 71% × oats 46% within granola = ~32.7% effective oat product-weight (composite sub-recipe with no parent_pct for the 46% sub-ingredient — requires multiplying through). Tests composite/sub-recipe parsing: lower product's oat% is embedded in a composite and effective oat content must be computed from the sub-recipe multiplication. Direction is unambiguous from arithmetic: 39% direct > 32.7% effective.
pair_results.stress_target: composite/sub-recipe structure — oat% inside composite must be multiplied through, not taken at face value
